title: Risk assessment of metal/bio-based nanopesticides: plant growth, soil environment, and non-target organisms
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2285-2296
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00941J, Paper
Jiabao Wu, Ningke Fan, Huimin Liao, Yejia Zhang, Zhenggao Xiao, Zhenyu Wang
This study comprehensively evaluated the health risks of metal-based (nCuO) and bio-based (nCS) nanopesticides on tomato plant growth, soil environment, and non-target organism tadpoles.
